rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that a place has many people, animals, or things.

example.jyutping: go3 gung1 jyun4 jau5 hou2 do1 zoek3 zai2

rows.note: Use this when the plentiful things are spread throughout an area or are found everywhere.

example.english: Shared bicycles abound throughout this city.
example.traditional: 呢座城市到處都有共享單車。
example.jyutping: ne1 zo6 sing4 si5 dou3 cyu3 dou1 jau5 gung6 hoeng2 daan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when emphasizing that things are extremely numerous and spread all over a place.

example.english: After the heavy rain, snails abound all over the park.
example.traditional: 落完大雨之後，公園遍地都係蝸牛。
example.jyutping: lok6 jyun4 daai6 jyu5 zi1 hau6 gung1 jyun2 pin3 dei6 dou1 hai6 wo1 ngau4
